rows.anchor: `resume_decision(*, mode, ordinal, guard, read, pending, dangling_branch, published)`
rows.anchor2: `release_decision(*, mode, ordinal, cycle_id, guard, read, applied_edits, target_sha, push_completed)`
rows.claim: Resume row 4 must re-enter release_decision but is given no target_sha or applied_edits, so a landed or normally completed push cannot pass the head proof and the PR stays draft instead of releasing.

rows.anchor: `published` computed with `held_cycle_published` so that a push that completed normally before the crash also releases
rows.claim: Resume never states that a released ci cycle resumes the CI wait with no re-trigger, so a resumed CI cycle can be sent down the review re-trigger path instead.

rows.anchor: `resume_reconciled` (live state matches the request and observed equals `run_toggles + 1`)
rows.claim: The exact run_toggles + 1 count ignores landed failed mutations that the toggle classifier already allows for, so an applied crashed request can reconcile as ambiguous and hold.

rows.anchor: The module imports only `enum`, `dataclasses`, `re` and `is_conflict_cycle` from `.conflicts`, and contains no `gh` or `git` word on any line.
rows.claim: The strict import whitelist forbids the package-style `from __future__ import annotations` the module would otherwise carry; harmless on Python 3.10+ and absent from the acceptance criteria.

rows.anchor: when it names an L3 or `draft` condition, or when the literal `off` line is missing, and passes on the real file.
rows.anchor2: and that at L3 with `--merge-guard off` the line "Remediation is unprotected: --merge-guard off." is printed once and no draft call is made
rows.claim: The Wave 0 test criterion can be read as forbidding any L3 mention while the same task mandates an L3-with-off sentence inside the bullet; only the passes-on-the-real-file clause resolves it toward gate wording.

rows.anchor: the timeline count uses `gh api --paginate` with a `jq` filter on `convert_to_draft` and `ready_for_review` piped to `wc -l`
rows.claim: Under set -euo pipefail a failed gh call aborts before the JSON prints, and without pipefail it reports zero transitions, so the transitions null and complete false check cannot pass as written.

rows.anchor: foreign toggle disables the guard and the run continues
rows.claim: A foreign ready toggle during a hold can leave the PR ready while a fix is unpushed, and the text does not say re-draft, halt or report-only.

rows.anchor: `git status --short` lists changes only under `src/superclaude/`, `tests/`, `docs/user-guide/`, `.dev/` and gitignored `.claude/` mirrors
rows.claim: git status never lists gitignored paths, so the expected list is vacuous for the .claude mirrors.
